name: Microsoft Copilot for finance
desc: Finance skills and plugins that run inside Copilot in Excel and Cowork.
desc_zh: 在 Copilot 的 Excel 和 Cowork 里运行的财务技能与插件。
solves: Month-end close means pulling numbers out of several systems by hand. The finance skills work on the real workbook and the ERP data behind it.
solves_zh: 月末结账要把几个系统里的数字手工汇总一遍。财务技能直接处理真实工作簿和背后的 ERP 数据。
best_for: A close, a variance review, or an investment memo is due and the data is spread out.
best_for_zh: 结账、差异复盘或投资备忘录要交，而数据散在各处。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — Microsoft Copilot Blog, https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/blog/2026/10）。 A named set of skills and plugins inside Copilot rather than a separate app. Accounting capabilities were still Frontier-only on 2026-10-29; Fabric IQ was generally available in Cowork the same day. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/copilot/blog/2026/10/29/microsoft-copilot-for-finance-purpose-built-for-the-way-finance-teams-work/
